Oh WOW! If you're a sushi lover, then look no further than Gold Sushi Restaurant in Riyadh. It was an absolutely amazing experience, from the moment we entered. The decor, the life like Samurai warriors, the ambience ans rhe service were all world class. We ordered a variety of appetizers ans mains and shared it all between the three of us, but the absolute show-stopper was the lobster tails, served on a miniature wooden boat, with dry ice, creating a little volcano on the boat, just for a bit of added presentation drama! It tasted as spectacular as it looked and I was hesitant to eat it and mess up the presentation. But don't take MY word for it...go see for yourself. It does not disappoint and the quiet, attentive staff's service was on point. Well done guys, we'll definitely be back!

It's been long overdue for me to visit Yautcha, and boy was i late to the party. The place is great with welcoming and attentive service, i tried the classic dim sum platter of 6 pieces, seabass one was nice, prawn was kind of dull, but the seafood black truffle was Wow. For the mains, i opted for Sanpei chicken, sweet and savoury with that lovely aroma of sweet basil, chicken was really tender. I also had the Singaporean vermicelli with prawns and squid, and i can't believe how soft that squid was, pure magic. I was disappointed that their mocktails were all unavailable because they looked great, and the drink I had was watered down and had no lemongrass flavour. I was too full for dessert but ordered it anyway, the pistachio cherry sesame, which unfortunately was a let down, the pistachio cremeaux was good, the cherry compote was too sour, the dates ice cream icy, but the biggest issue was the pasty which just didn't taste good, and the green stuff on the outside also, it was not an enjoyable dessert that i left half of it uneaten.
Yautcha is a must visit with great ambience, food, and service. They just need better music lol

There was natural vacuum of a good churrascaria place in Riyadh after the only one in the city has gone down the hill from quality standpoint.
Set in upscale setting in modern crown Plaza hotel inside the Riyadh Digital City, Wildfire offered good cuts of meats and other salad and soup options.
We were served by waiter John, who has been very helpful throughout the servings and was timely available for our needs at the table.
As churrascarias are always heavy, we didn’t go to the desert round, however the salad and mains were great except for a few cults of meats that were a bit hard to chew, and the grilled pineapple was. Really fully ripe and sweet. That’s how the food I rated as 4 stars. Definitely there is a need of improvement in meat quality in some cuts.

Excellent experience.
- Ambience: I enjoyed the vibes and the background music. The decor is on point and it’s got a very nice sea-view which I truly enjoyed with my family.
- Food: excellent quality, unique presentation fits the concept, quality ingredients. The chocolate fondue dessert was nice as well. Very balanced, although I feel it needs more of salted caramel crumbs , the dessert felt it needs a bite kick of salt in it.
- Prices: I found them fair for the experience this place has to offer. I’ve attached my bill.
- Service: knowledgeable service team and very welcoming.
What enjoyed the most:
Passion mojito, Sweet corn and Kale Salad, Japanese Rice with wild mushrooms and truffle , the Grilled salmon.
The Wagyu thing was nice but I wouldn’t comeback for it as well as the Shrimp tempura. The positive thing about the shrimp tempura is that it’s not greasy like most places.
I will repeat the experience next time it will be dinner as I want to experience the night vibes.
Thank you

It has huge floor space and roamed by attentive waiters who are ready to explain the menu and take the order, special mention to Sharat. While waiting, they will serve unlimited French Bread which one can dip into special balsamic sauce with olive oil or in a soup. Don’t each much though in order to enjoy the main course. I also tried the Saudi Latte which was nice. They offer Buy1Take1 discount using Entertainer app, or give 25% discount if one has Aramco ID. It is a bit pricey but it’s worth the experience.

Located in the Mutal Complex, this Cafe Bateel location offers both indoor and outdoor seating. Once you enter, you are greeted immediately by friendly staff, who offer you direction to seating. The menu offers a great selection. This particular outing was for breakfast with a view. So we were seated on the terrace, with spectacular sea views.
For drinks, we ordered freshly squeezed orange juice, Americano coffee and Saudi Latte. The Saudi Latte is a definite must try, made with the cafe's signature coffee (with cardamon), a shot of espresso, then topped with frothed with a hint of raw saffron. The aroma of this coffee is amazing, and is matched by its taste.
For Breakfast, we ordered the Halloumi and Avocado toast and the Date French Toast.
Before the drinks arrived, we were offered a basket of bread with sides of date butter and regular butter from France. The date butter is worth a try, it is subtle in favour and a perfect match with the fresh bread.
The presentation of the breakfast was stellar. The plates were a perfect blend of colour and taste.
I would highly recommend a visit, will definitely be back.
Vegetarian options: Plenty of delicious options.
Wheelchair accessibility: Elevator and ramp access to all the complex.

1. Exceptional Culinary Journey: The Cheesecake Factory consistently delivers a culinary delight with exquisite flavors. I've had the pleasure of savoring their dishes multiple times, from the flavorful Korean chicken to the satisfying barbecue ranch chicken salad and the delightful lunch chicken special.
2. Complimentary Bread and Butter: Adding to the experience, the restaurant provides a variety of complimentary bread with butter, enhancing the overall enjoyment of the meal without any additional cost.
3. Refreshing Beverage Choices: Personal favorites among their beverages include the vibrant raspberry lemonade and the unfortunately sectioned pomegranate drink, showcasing a diverse and appealing drink selection.
4. Indulgent Dessert Finale: The GODIVA® CHOCOLATE BROWNIE SUNDAE dessert was a standout, offering a rich and indulgent conclusion to the dining experience.
5. Exceptional Service: The service at The Cheesecake Factory is truly outstanding, with a majority of the staff displaying professionalism and politeness, contributing to a positive overall atmosphere.
6. Versatile Atmosphere: The restaurant caters to diverse preferences with both indoor and outdoor seating options, providing a great atmosphere suitable for various occasions.
7. Overall Charming Experience: From its welcoming starting point to its expansive menu, The Cheesecake Factory consistently excels in all aspects of the dining experience.
9. Premium Pricing, Justified: While the prices may be on the higher side, the remarkable quality of food, exceptional service, and versatile atmosphere make it unquestionably worth the investment.
10. Family-Friendly Atmosphere: The Cheesecake Factory further stands out as a great choice for families, offering a welcoming and accommodating atmosphere that enhances the overall dining experience.

Our reservation was made for brunch at 3pm on 26th of January, we came in to celebrate my husband’s birthday, but unfortunately it turned out to be a disaster.
Service from reception was good upon arrival and our waiter was prompt in taking the order for us and explain which dishes we would be able to enjoy as we have some dietary requirements.
Prawn crackers and water to start took already over 10 minutes to touch our table even though we were the only ones in the restaurant; from here, everything started to go downhill: Our appetisers (dim sum) took ages to arrive to then be left with an empty table for 50 minutes waiting for our mains, rice and noodles - upon checking we were served after 10 more minutes with our noodles and rice, waited an extra 15 minutes and then our first (out of 4!) main course finally came. At this stage our rice was already cold and we refused to get any more food since it already was 4:45pm and barely any food was served to us even though the whole place was empty until 4pm. The manager was nowhere to be seen, until we asked for him - nonetheless we weren’t impressed at all with his reaction as it seemed quite normal for this to happen. We love Shang’s Palace all over the world and when we have the chance we visit, but unfortunately Jeddah’s one has been the worst by far to date. Birthday celebration was ruined!

My wife and I had a pleasant night out at Shang Plus. It was our first visit, and we ordered two appetizers and two main courses. The Wagyu pastry puff was delightful, but the Canadian lobster salad didn't quite meet our expectations. As for the main courses, the baked cod and Wagyu beef tenderloin were decent, although we found ourselves comparing them to other Asian restaurants in Jeddah. It felt like they could put in more effort to stand out. On a positive note, the mocktails, especially the blooming mojito, were amazing. The dessert, passion fruit creamperle, was also enjoyable.
Additionally, we appreciated the friendly reception and attentive service from the waiter. The ambiance of the restaurant was pleasant, creating a nice dining atmosphere. However, it's worth noting that the prices were on the higher side.

Shang Palace is by far the best modern Chinese restaurant and only place in Jeddah that offers a glimpse into what real modern Chinese fine dining is all about.
The ambiance is wow, beautiful carpets, wood panelled walls with traditional vases display and great lighting for the dining everywhere give it that intimate modern Chinese dining room feel.
Kudos to the front of the house team and to the chef especially Chef Keith Yap he really passionate about making unforgettable food and great dining experience for each guest.
The food is excellent, was there to try their new Shang Palace Dim Dum brunch series and were absolutely delighted with the food.
It's unlimited course of dim sum, few mains in the menu to choose from and a dessert for closing of our meal.
Loved all the dim sum and the Hong Kong style chicken.
It's a must-try place, great for special occasions.

Allow me to share with you my humble experience in Brioché ...
We love to provide you with the perfect evaluation for several places around specially breakfast restaurants because we have suffered alot when it comes to select a place for our Breakfast 🥞🍳, but most of the varieties around are not worthy of trying specially whatever the Social Media Parasitic Hoaxs advertise , only Pathetic Followers fall into such trap , that's why we want to provide an extremely honest experience for any place we attend to for the sake of awareness , so stay tuned...
1- Place and the design:
They are trying their best to provide you with some European Vibes with the design and the colours but they failed dramatically which ended up with eye irritation, mood abuse and uncomfortable seats but still they have used such small space they have quite good 5/10.
2- The hospitality:
The crew were good with their overwhelming welcome and care of all what we need following all the precautionary regulations for our safety and they were fast despite their confusion and unclear regulations towards Main Courses and Breakfast Menu 7/10.
3- Our order and the food quality:
We have ordered Dolce De Lechi , Americano , Briggs , Berioche House Cured Salmon , the ingredients were 6/10 fresh, the look was nice with the Berioche delicious texture 7/10, the taste was delicious due to the Carbs effect 7/10, and the quality of the food for the Price 5/10 so far.
4- The experience conclusion:
It was a fair experience, as we are talking here about simple ingredients with a specific bread 🍞 , also it's quite annoying to me that how come a place serve breads and don't have valid Coffee or Tea ☕ just sticking to the commercial types , which directly damage the quality of the experience , but despite all of that still a new experience that you can enjoy somehow , call it Carbs Dopamine Effect or the need for the Food industry to upgrade , which made it one of the good Breakfast Restaurants in Jeddah city in my opinion and if there is another, refer/share it so we can try it out 6/10.

42 / 70

2nd- Bay Rock

If you're in Riyadh and craving the mouthwatering flavors of Texas-style BBQ, look no further! I recently had the pleasure of dining at this restaurant, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations.
As a BBQ aficionado with a deep appreciation for Texas BBQ, I was delighted to find beef ribs, briskets, and even a brisket burger on the menu. Each dish was a delightful explosion of flavors that took me straight back to the BBQ joints I love in Texas.
The beef ribs were tender and perfectly seasoned, falling off the bone with every bite. The briskets were smoked to perfection, boasting that distinct smoky flavor I cherish. And the brisket burger, oh my! It was a brilliant fusion of BBQ goodness, and I couldn't get enough of it.
The restaurant's ambiance was warm and welcoming, providing a comfortable setting to enjoy the fantastic meal. The staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the dishes they served, which added to the overall dining experience.
If you're a BBQ enthusiast like me or simply someone looking for an extraordinary culinary experience, this restaurant is a must-visit in Riyadh. I can't recommend it enough! Prepare your taste buds for a tantalizing journey through the flavors of Texas right here in Saudi Arabia.

لا تكلمني إنكليزي انت عربي سوري وادفع غصب من عنك إذا فيك ضمير

Over 35 SAR of cardamon
THE WORST EXPERIENCE IN MY LIFE
I FEAL ASHAMMED TO HAVE THIS treatment in the land of generosity Saudi Arabia
I will file a official complaint with ministry of tourism
I paid for the broken jar but I did not take anything else from Bateel and I will never go back again to your establishments

Takara Restaurant in Al Khobar is a true culinary haven that enraptured my senses during a recent dinner outing. From the moment we stepped inside, the delightful blend of modern elegance and traditional warmth set the stage for an exceptional dining experience.
The ambiance at Takara is inviting, with tasteful interior design elements that create a cozy yet sophisticated atmosphere. The attention to detail is evident, making every corner of the restaurant a visual delight. The pleasant aroma that greeted us upon entry heightened our anticipation for the culinary journey ahead.
Now, onto the star of the show – the food. Takara's menu is a showcase of culinary prowess, featuring an array of dishes that blend traditional Japanese flavors with innovative twists. The sushi was a highlight, a perfect marriage of fresh ingredients and expert craftsmanship. Each roll was a burst of vibrant colors and flavors, a testament to the chef's dedication to the art of Japanese cuisine.
The sashimi, with its impeccable freshness and melt-in-your-mouth texture, further underscored the restaurant's commitment to sourcing high-quality seafood. The Teriyaki Salmon, a hot dish on the menu, was a standout. The perfectly grilled salmon, glazed with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, was accompanied by crisp vegetables, creating a symphony of flavors on the palate.
Beyond the culinary delights, the service at Takara was impeccable. The staff's professionalism and attentiveness elevated the dining experience. Our server was knowledgeable, offering insightful recommendations and ensuring our preferences were met. The pacing of the courses allowed us to savor each dish, contributing to a relaxed and enjoyable evening.
The attention to detail extended to every aspect of the service, from the pristine table settings to the genuine smiles of the staff. It was evident that customer satisfaction is a top priority for the Takara team, and their efforts to create a memorable dining experience did not go unnoticed.
The ambiance, with its well-calibrated lighting and carefully chosen background music, complemented the overall experience. It struck the perfect balance between creating a sophisticated atmosphere and allowing for comfortable conversation. Takara proved to be more than just a restaurant; it was a destination for those seeking an immersive culinary journey through Japanese cuisine.
In summary, Takara Restaurant in Al Khobar exceeded expectations, offering a culinary adventure that tantalized the taste buds and left a lasting impression. Whether you're a Japanese cuisine enthusiast or someone in search of an extraordinary dining experience, Takara is a must-visit. From the delightful ambiance to the exceptional service and mouthwatering dishes, Takara has solidified its place among Al Khobar's finest culinary establishments.

Service: the waiters are very very friendly.

Milan's Exceptional Hospitality and South African Nostalgia at Its Finest!
Our dining experience at The Butcher Shop & Grill on Tahlia Street was truly unforgettable, thanks to the exceptional hospitality of Milan. His warm and attentive service made us feel like cherished guests, enhancing the nostalgic ambiance of South Africa that permeates the restaurant.
We opted for the Mix Grill for 2, and it was a feast for the senses! The sizzling meats, reminiscent of a true South African braai, filled the air with irresistible aromas. Tender and perfectly grilled, the variety of meats delighted our palates, while the accompanying sides added a delightful touch to the meal.
Milan's expertise in recommending the best dishes and ensuring every detail was taken care of made the experience even more enjoyable. The cozy seating and inviting ambiance transported us back to fond memories of dining with friends and family in South Africa.
If you're longing for an exceptional dining experience that combines the warmth of South African nostalgia with a delicious mix grill shared with loved ones, The Butcher Shop & Grill on Tahlia Street is the place to be. Thanks to Milan's remarkable hospitality, it was a dining journey we'll cherish for a lifetime.
Best part is 20% off as South African. Do inquire by the waiter.

I highly recommend this place and would definitely come again.

You can simply enjoy a cup of tea or coffee, snack on fresh dates, indulge yourself with some delicious dessert, or you can have a tasteful meal including a large variety of soups, healthy salads, main courses, pastas, and sandwiches. Unfortunately, the dining space is not well managed and the seats and tables aren't comfortable, not even for a casual dining venue. The ambiance in general is not bad, however, the service is excellent. The café has two indoor stories and an outdoor area. Personally, I've never liked  dining at the terrace, since it is literally situated on the car park, yet, surprisingly, it is always packed, especially during the night time and good weather. Inside the café, there's an elegant boutique offering high quality dates.

We took our daughter to Yauatcha Riyadh, being her first time to dine here. We opted for two Eagle menu to share, and added two steam dumpling plates as well. If you want to experience real good quality ingredients transformed into fantastically tasty dishes, you can't go wrong at Yauatcha. We had the crunchiest bakchoy dish...the bakchoy stem was more like a celery stick. The "wok tossed" ribeye beef was so succulent and soft, the kung pao chicken was juicy, the tiger prawns were crunchy...practically all the dishes were great. I highly recommend this Chinese restaurant over another one in Diriyah.
Special mention for Miko, who was very attentive, knowledgeable and yet considerate.

Great experience
We meant to celebrate a late valentines and they made it memorable.
They will continue valentines theme until late February.
First of all the sunset view is amazing especially with jeddah winter clouds if you’re celebrating a loved one sunset is the time to go.
As for the service it was really great out waiter was very helpful, took his time to explain the dishes and the sauces.
We ordered the colorful dumplings and puff pastry beef (the ones that come in a mini purse) I promise its flavor is even more artistic than its design. We also ordered(their special duck) tastes really good they cook it in a way that its not as heavy and they add this amazing crunch to it , definitely a must try.
For the dessert, the heart shaped one in the pictures didn’t taste good , honestly its filled with cream and has strong rose water flavor I, I think they need to enhance the berry and chocolate flavor to improve it.
Anyways they were nice enough to change our desert into creme burlee which tasted good but I heard they have better options.
Overall it was great , if there is room for improvement my tip would be to keep an eye on details. In similar classy restaurant the waiters usually would pull the chairs for us to seat us take our purse and hang it . They also didn’t offer to give us the rest of our duck as take away although there was so much left of it.

With its cosy and quite atmosphere this place makes for a perfect escape or a reset to very busy week. Go to Takara to treat yourself or celebrate a special occasion. This small restaurant captures elegance in ambience, decor, service and food. Our waiter was experienced, well spoken and very courteous. She made us feel extremely welcome. I was there around 7:30 pm on a Thursday night. The place was not packed when we arrived. Maybe that allowed for the very fast service we experienced. By the time we left almost all tables were occupied yet the general atmosphere remained nice and quite.
Despite the fast service, the food quality in every thing we ordered was outstanding. The crispy salad was full of extremely balanced flavors and was a perfect start for our meal. I also ordered a medium black angus steak and I absolutely loved it. This steak does need any additional salt, pepper, or any sauces because it’s already full of flavor, cooked to perfection and melts away in your mouth.
Prices are a bit on the high end but the experience was definitely worth it. I would coming again for sure.
Well done Takara!! 👌

It was a rainy day, and we decided to go for lunch outside. We chose Zafran Indian Bistro located on Turki Alawal street. The street was flooded with rainwater. Thanks to the wallet parking, we saved our time and rushed to the restaurant in heavy rain. The ambiance was good. We got a seat near the window to enjoy the outside rains. We ordered Papri Chaat with aloo samosas for starters. We ordered Raan Roast (lamb leg), chicken tikka, malai boti, chicken tandoori, and hummus achari for the main course. Gulab jamun and ras malai for dessert with masala tea.
Papari chaat: The presentation was good, but it was too sweet for our taste. We added samosas, which increased the taste of Papari chaat.
Lamb leg roast: The presentation was really good. The coal smoke was overdone, which killed the taste. It is not recommended to be ordered.
Chicken malai was soft and tender.
Chicken tandoori was also delicious.
Chicken boti was also delicious.
Achari hummus with roti was good.
Gulaab jamun was served hot and was tasty.
Raas malai with mango puree and berries was awesome.
Masala tea was too strong in flavor.
Overall, the experience was good, but it is a bit expensive. The total bill was around 500. I would rate it 7 out of 10.
column12: Zafran Indian Kitchen - Turki Square_M Atif Ikram_1

I had been hearing amazing things about Zafran Indian Bistro ‘s “Jashn-e-Kebab” Menu and decided to give it a try!
I visited Zafran’s branch in The View Mall and chose to be seated indoors due to the freezing weather.
The staff were kind & cooperative and brought our food out almost immediately.
I ordered :
• Chaat Platter
• zafran feast Platter
• Butter Chicken
• Lamb Biryani
• Gulab Jamun
The Jashn-e-Kebab Platter was the best thing ever! It was accompanied by home-made dips made by the chefs. So much variety i didnt know where to start from. Everything was so delicious. The Kaffir Lime Jinghe were probably my favourite off the Jashn-e-Kebab Platter.
Their Butter Chicken is my favorite one I have ever tried at an Indian Restaurant in Riyadh and it was upto the mark as usual. Chaat Platter is also now a staple in my order.
I had an incredible time and was blown away by how good the food was, as i am every time. Highly recommend you all give their Jashn-e-Kebab menu a try, you won’t be disappointed!!

Went on a Friday for lunch at 3 pm and had the Dim Sum Brunch. It was supposed to be all you can eat dim sum, but because it took at least 15-20 minutes between our first dim sum and the second one, when we came to order an extra dim sum the waiter told us we couldn’t as the brunch time was finished. When the waiter took our main menu order he also took our dessert order, but when we were ready for dessert the waiter told us the one we had ordered was finished so we had to choose from something we didn’t even want. Most of the dim sum were delicious, but the crispy duck was not what I expected. Only the outside of it was crispy as they used kanafa pastry. The chicken fried rice was very basic and the quail dish was very tiny for a main course. It was more like an appetizer in portion. The blue colored tea was delicious though. Not sure I would go there again.

We recently dined at Yauatcha in Riyadh, and we were impressed with the quality of the food and the restaurant's beautiful atmosphere. The dishes were expertly crafted, and each one had a unique flavor profile that left us wanting more.
For our appetizer, we tried the spinach cream soup, which was smooth and creamy, with a subtle spinach flavor. The dim sum was exceptional, particularly the blue swimmer crab dumpling and the wagyu puff, which were both bursting with flavor. We also enjoyed the omni meat soya corn crystal dumpling and mushroom dumpling.
For our main course, we savored the southern poached chili red garoupa fish and sacha beef. The fish was cooked to perfection and the beef was tender and flavorful. We also loved the chicken lettuce wrap and sautéed garlic wild asparagus. The vegetable egg fried rice was the perfect complement to the meal.
To end the night on a sweet note, we indulged in the dates, passion fruit, and mandarin cake. It was the perfect blend of flavors and textures.
The staff were friendly and attentive, and the elegant atmosphere added to the overall experience. We highly recommend Yauatcha for anyone looking for outstanding Cantonese cuisine in a beautiful setting. Five stars, without hesitation!

I recently visited the Cheesecake Factory and I have to say, it was an incredible experience. The restaurant had a lively atmosphere and the service was top-notch from beginning to end. As for the food, I tried a few different items and each one was better than the last.
The fried mac and cheese balls were definitely a highlight of the meal. They were crispy on the outside and rich and gooey on the inside, making for a perfect combination of textures and flavors. The egg roll sampler was another standout dish, with a variety of flavors and fillings to choose from. It was a great way to try a few different things and find some new favorites.
And then there were the roadside sliders - juicy beef patties with a delicious blend of toppings that made for a satisfying and tasty meal. The portion size was just right, leaving me feeling full but not overly stuffed.

The fried mac and cheese balls were definitely a highlight of the meal. They were crispy on the outside and rich and gooey on the inside, making for a perfect combination of textures and flavors. The egg roll sampler was another standout dish, with a variety of flavors and fillings to choose from. It was a great way to try a few different things and find some new favorites.
And then there were the roadside sliders - juicy beef patties with a delicious blend of toppings that made for a satisfying and tasty meal. The portion size was just right, leaving me feeling full but not overly stuffed.
Overall, I would highly recommend the Cheesecake Factory to anyone looking for a fun and delicious dining experience. The food was delicious, the service was great, and the atmosphere was lively and welcoming. I can't wait to go back and try more of the menu!

I have visited Mizo Island, to be honest the place looks wonderful but there were a lot of Flies and the AC is not cold. Service is bad the drinks came after the main course. the Risotto came after we almost finished everything. The music in my opinion was not suitable for the restaurant atmosphere.
Regarding the food the presentation looks good but the food did not taste that good. Our orders are
Gambre Kickin: The flavor was below average and tasteless. shrimp tastes like frozen it is  not fresh.
Mozzarella crazy: The taste and presentation were good I recommend it.
Tuscany Fries: Was disappointing, the name of the dish gave you the impression that it is going to be good but unfortunately it was not.
MIZO Spechial Pizza: Below average.
Beef Sliders: We ordered them to be medium well but it was well done, nothing is special about it.
Beef Risotto: In my opinion the curry was not a good flavor for the Risotto and it was overcoming the other ingredients
I do not recommend this restaurant it doesn't worth the wait and price

The Cheesecake Factory in Riyadh is a fantastic place to indulge in delicious food, especially their renowned cheesecakes. From the moment you step foot in the restaurant, you are greeted with a vibrant and lively ambiance that sets the stage for a memorable dining experience.
The menu at the Cheesecake Factory offers an extensive selection of dishes that cater to various tastes and preferences. Whether you're in the mood for appetizers, salads, pasta, burgers, or their famous cheesecakes, there is something for everyone. The portion sizes are generous, so it's best to come hungry or be prepared to take some leftovers home.
Speaking of the cheesecakes, they are the true stars of the show at the Cheesecake Factory. With an array of flavors to choose from, it can be quite challenging to pick just one. From classic options like the Original Cheesecake to more unique creations like the Oreo Dream Extreme Cheesecake, each slice is a slice of heaven. The cheesecakes are rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced in sweetness, making them an absolute delight for dessert lovers.
The service at the Cheesecake Factory Riyadh is top-notch. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. They are happy to provide recommendations or accommodate any special requests you may have.

‘Dim Sum Night’ takes place once a month and dates aren’t confirmed for the next event, but I’ll make sure to keep you guys posted on the dates. At SR. 180 per person, this doesn’t come cheap but the experience is worth it.
From ‘Steamed’ to ‘Fried’ selections of dumplings, we were served with some remarkable variations that I had never come across.
In the ‘Steamed’, I enjoyed the ‘Jelly Crab Dumpling’ which can look quite unsettling to some with its vivid and slimy exterior but it was delightful. The ‘Steamed Saffron Lobster’ & ‘Shui Jiao Spicy Prawn Dumpling’ were also really good with the latter packing a tiny amount of heat. The ‘Crystal Shrimp Dumpling’ was just ok and weirdly I quite enjoyed the “Spinach Dumpling’. The menu isn’t very vegan or vegetarian friendly but you can order these ‘Dim Sums’ separately if you need to.
The ‘Fried’ selection was my favourite and some of the items really stood out. The absolute best of the lot was the ‘Wagyu Puff with Black Pepper Mayo’ with the beef being the highlight. It was tender and the sauce really added that extra zing. The puff had managed to retain its crispy outer layer without the filling turning it mushy. The ‘Tiger Prawn with Spicy Mayo’ was the next best thing and I really wish they brought in a few extras. The ‘Pan Fried Chicken Bun’ was also delicious and so was the ‘Sesame Prawn Toast’ with its crispy outer exterior and delicious prawn center. Ahmed and I decided to finish off the meal by ordering a Dessert, so we went for the ‘Frozen Macadamia Soufflé with Hot Chocolate Sauce’ (SR. 50). Loved the macadamia and soufflé’s combination and it is a bit heavy. This would be a great share for 2-3 people if you aren’t looking to down a whole dessert. I will keep you guys posted on future dates once I get confirmation.

Will definitely come back.

Located inside Crown plaza hotel Riyadh, Wildfire is a wonderful Brazilian concept steakhouse.
I have had the Brazilian steakhouse experience previously in Malaysia and was delighted to find a replacement (even better) here in KSA.
For my husband's birthday I wanted to go here for dinner so I contacted their manager Mr Amro who was quick to get back to me to arrange my reservation and also inform me how they can make the birthday more fun.
Fast forward, we visited yesterday and it was an absolute delight! From their service (shoutout to Wilson) to the food everything was spot on! The quality of cuts they offered and the salad bar (I am still dreaming about it)
We opted for their full course dinner which included a large variety of cuts from prawns to chicken to ribs to steaks. They ask you for the temperature you prefer and bring you the cuts accordingly. My personal favorites were the bacon wrapped chicken, the sirloin and smoked ribs to name a few. And their cinnamon sugar pineapple as a final serve was sooo good!
For drinks I ordered their sangria which was halal red wine with some fruits to give it a sweet kick, it was the perfect pairing with the meat.
Honestly I wanted to keep eating even after spending two hours but my stomach was like no stop hehe
They offered us complimentary welcome drinks and also served a special complimentary dessert for my husband and all the staff gathered and wished him happy birthday in Brazilian plate cracking style (so fun)
Can't wait to return soon for another wonderful experience! Keep up the great work.
10/10 recommended
P.s they have some amazing deals running these days with happy hour and weekend buffets so call them and check your options.
Thankyou once again to Mr Amro and the team!

-Crema brula’a (my favorite sweet)

Myazo in Jeddah is hands-down my favorite place to eat in the city. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with top-notch service and a vibe that just feels right. It’s not just about the food here; it’s the whole experience.
Speaking of the food, I’ve pretty much tried everything on the menu, and it never disappoints. The sushi is always fresh, and each dish is a burst of flavors that you won’t forget. But what I really love is how the menu has something for everyone. Even when I’m on a diet, Myazo has got me covered with amazing salads like the avocado grilled salad and the Alaskan crab salad. They’re so good, you’d never think you were eating something “healthy.”
The service is five stars all the way. The staff is attentive and makes you feel at home. Every visit feels special, and that’s a rare thing to find these days.
All in all, if you’re in Jeddah and looking for an amazing dining experience, Myazo is the place to be. It’s more than just a meal; it’s an experience you won’t want to miss.

Allow me to share with you my humble experience in Il Gabbiano...
1- Place and the design:
It's a Classic Classy Italian Design well maintained which is an old vibes that takes you to the Napoli 1990's time realm with It's specific atmosphere and smell, with something i didn't expect which the crowds of all the Original Italian food lovers all over the place, although they have a great view    on the Kornaish, but we have realised that the whole building 🏢 have blinded the Northern view of the Kornaish for no reason, but it is okay and have nothing to do with the restaurant evaluation any how, except for the double layer entrance door🚪they have, that suppose to stop flys 💸 from entring the place but they exist inside any way 7/10.
2- The hospitality:
The crew were super nice 🙂 and professionals with their friendly welcome and care of all what we need following all the precautionary regulations for our safety    and they were fast , providing you with all what you need and prefer, this is what you can call true pro service from the heart ❤️ 8/10.
3- Our order and the food quality:
We have ordered 2 of the main flagship dishes they have which are, Tarabani Con Salsa Mugnaia 🐠 and Special Tagliata 🍖, also we ordered Salmon Rosa 🐟, Fettuccini Verdi Gratinate pasta 🍝 , Asparaggi Alla Parmiggiana 🧀 , Zuppa Inglese 🍰 all this with their marvelous complimentary Dish wish is Bread 🍞 , vegetables 🍅 , Olive    and Butter   , the ingredients were 6/10 fresh, the look was beautiful 7/10, the taste was one of the best with the Fettuccini Verdi Gratinate but not this good with the Tarabani Con Salsa Mugnaia 6/10, and the quality of the food was (for the price) 4/10 so far.
4- The experience conclusion:
It was an Italian classy luxurious experience with one of the best views    in Jeddah , as it is one of the oldest and best Italian restaurants in Jeddah city 🏙️ , of course i am the one who ordered the Tarabani Con Salsa Mugnaia and i felt guilty ordering it with the wish that i have ordered the Nagil Santini dish as i have been asked for the flagship dishes there and Tarabani was the one 🤦🏻 , the guilt have encresed when i tasted it , it was delicious but didn't fullfill my expectations , and it might be because of the high calories it had , despite all such sad part we have enjoyed the time to the fullest with High quality delicious dishes, magnificent services, wonderful view of the Sea ⛵ 🌊 which make it one of the glorious Italian restaurants in Jeddah city in my opinion with such unforgotten advantages which are very limited regretfully and if there is another, refer/share it so we can try it out , by the way, they got a functional Piano 🎹 inside if you want to play some 7/10.

Had a wonderful experience. We went for lunch. Took the lunch offer. We were 3 persons. Took one 89 riyal package and two 69 riyal package. In a package u can choose the main dish and each main dishe will come with a soup, salad,a loaf of bread and drinks. We had  delicious creamy broccoli soup( there was lentil and creamy broccoli soup, we choose brocolli soup), the salad options were green salad and Greek salad. Then there was one loaf of buttery delicous bushman bread which was tooo good. Soup and salad portion was enough. For drinks we can choose Pepsi 7 up etc or iced tea. Iced tea plain is included in the package, but if we need any flavors we need to pay 3 riyal etc. We took peach flavor which was really good. Drinks are refillable. For the main course we had brisket combo (89 riyal category) which included a moderate sized super delicious steak, grilled shrimps, and grilled chicken. It was tasting amazing. And a Tuscan smothered chicken and toowoomba chicken from 69 riyal category. All these main dishes u can choose whether it's to be served with grilled veg, french fries, rice or mashed potato as side.we choose 3 diff sides for our 3 main dishes so we could taste all. The prices are INCLUSIVE of tax. Food was amazing. I felt Toowoomba chicken a bit salty. That was the only flaw I could find. The ambience is nice, overlooking the fanateer beach.but surpsingly I found their tables a bit small , like if 4 adults sit on a table, it can a bit crampy. I don't know whether it's just my feeling 😜😜. They don't have separate cubicles for familes , if u want privacy u can ask and they will put that foldable partition panel near our table so we can enjoy our meals in privacy  . They have nice outdoor sitting area also. If the climate is good outdoor seating can be tried. The waiters were really good and helpful. They will even ask u the minutest details on how we would like our food to be served. Like whether we want the sauce to be served with the dish or separate. Over all a nice cozy experience.
Check the QR code for menu. If you visit more than 4 times you can add it to your localty account and claim a free starter also.

The Cheesecake Factory is a very decent and good restaurant in Jeddah. The food is delicious, especially the cheesecakes, which are amazing. The pizza was good, though the size was rather small. The orange chicken had a slightly sweetish taste. Steak Diane which is their signature dish is good too. Overall, the food quality is good, the taste is good but not outstanding as such, and the portion sizes are generous.
My favorite item is the cheesecake, particularly the chocolate varieties. I've tried the Godiva Cheesecake, 30th Anniversary Cheesecake, and Hershey’s Cheesecake, all of which were excellent. The non-chocolate options, like the Red Velvet Cheesecake and Salted Caramel Cheesecake, were good but not as outstanding as the chocolate ones.
The atmosphere and ambiance are very pleasant, and the service is great. However, the prices are quite high. A small bottle of water costs 23 rials, which I believe is excessive. While the food prices are on the higher side, they are acceptable. Still, the pricing of water and drinks is unreasonable and should be reconsidered by the restaurant, as these prices are not justified.
Overall a good, a little pricey and very decent place to enjoy your dinner with your special ones.

I recently had the opportunity to visit the Cheese Cake Factory in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by friendly staff and a warm, inviting atmosphere.
The first thing that caught my eye was the extensive menu. There were so many options to choose from, ranging from traditional American dishes to local Saudi specialties. As a cheese lover, I was delighted to see a variety of cheese cakes on the menu, along with a wide selection of other desserts.
I started my meal with the avocado egg rolls and they were delicious. The combination of crispy egg rolls with creamy avocado filling was a perfect start to my dining experience. For my main course, I ordered the Cajun Jambalaya pasta and it did not disappoint. The portion size was generous and the flavors were spot on.
Aside from the delicious food, I was also impressed by the service. Our server was attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The food also came out in a timely manner, which was a plus.
One thing that stood out to me about the Cheese Cake Factory in Jeddah was the attention to detail in the decor. The restaurant had a modern yet cozy feel to it, with comfortable seating and beautiful lighting. It was also very clean and well-maintained.
Overall, I had a fantastic experience at the Cheese Cake Factory in Jeddah. The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was inviting. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a tasty and enjoyable dining experience in Jeddah. Whether you're a local or a tourist, the Cheese Cake Factory is a must-visit spot. I will definitely be returning for more of their delicious cheese cakes!

The first vist was perfect 5 stars, but the 2nd one was disappointing.  Regarding of the food quality and taste.
Yakasaki Sushi: Average taste I could not taste the lobster as the cheese cream overcomes the taste of the other ingredients or the portion of the lobster was too little to be tasted.
Angus beef with trafel: We could not complete the dish, the beef has undesirable smell and taste. It looks like it was not fresh. Also, it has a weird texture I have never experinced with any beef befor. The onion pieces  were big and uncooked.
Mixed noodle with oyster sauce: nothing special about it. the shrimp was rubbery.
Crispy honey chicken: the only thing we ate that day, I do recommend it. The onion pieces were big and uncooked.
Iced lemon tea: Homemade, it is good, but not the best.
Strawberry Mojito: below average.
Price: very high in comparison to the new dishes' portion and the food quality.
Service and Restaurant atmosphere: it is great, and the service is fast. No waiting time.
I do not recommend it at all unless they return back to their old flavour and quality.

This was an unexpected Chinese food trip and for years I have not revisited this place. I have forgotten why I didn't try it again but of course things change in time😆 and I'm happy one of my friends chose this..
They served the food on our table by gonging the metal plate cover while doing a certain beat that gave us an appetising feeling before we devour the smoking hot dishes..
Food wise, they got an amazing flavor that was satisfying to our taste buds and is surely an option if we crave for Chinese cuisine again.
The servers were attentive and courteous. Oh I forgot to mention that that they have this crackling as a complimentary appetiser with sweet sour sauce and chilli oil... they also  gave us free mini cakes for dessert.
For some comment that needs improvement, the place was too dark and the cutleries are not grip friendly.. it easily slips since the handle is like a chopstick and would have been better of it was flat.
Overall this this restaurant deserves a try and   who knows could be your fave Chinese restaurant too.

My friends took me to Poke Bowl for a belated birthday dinner. When they said it was sushi in a bowl I wasn't too sure it would be good. But it was delicious! They have a bowl size for every appetite. I was really hungry so I got a large bowl. It was too much, but hey, I got leftovers🤤 the price was great for the quality and quantity of food you get. It is way cheaper than getting sushi at other places in Jeddah which, will ensure me coming back again. The environment was very clean and the decor was industrial meets beachside cafe. If you have been to Panda Express in the US it works in pretty much the same way. Very limited drink selection which could be much improved. They only had Sprite, Coke, Diet Coke, and 2 types of water.🙁 Make sure to finish dinner with a bowl of Matcha ice cream which was lovely.

The place was wonderful because of the food, staff and atmosphere. There were amazing drawings and figures and the walls and there also was also some cool samurai armor. The food was wonderful and even though we got five orders of sushi and calamari, it had a pretty good price. But the best thing was the staff. There was one staff member called Charlie and he was extremely kind. He gave us Saudi champagne and some cake FOR FREE. He was very kind and always kept fixing our table up and making sure we had everything we wanted. Please show him some love and if you go there, make sure you choose him as your waiter. Me and my mother went there a couple of months ago and told him that my sister would love to be here and when we brought her, he remembered us and was very talkative. But this doesn’t mean he treated nice because he knew us, because he was treating us really nicely last time when we met him for the first time. He’s truly a great person at heart and an amazing staff member. We really need more people like him.
Kid-friendliness: Children ( including me [im 14]), so teenagers and even infants were dining with me and they didn’t cause trouble and the staff didn’t mind them.
Wheelchair accessibility: I saw people who unfortunately were in wheel chairs and they easily found a place to sit in and were from what I saw treated properly and fairly.

Review by a couple from London 🇬🇧
We discovered this place by google search and read the reviews of trusted people and thought to give it a try. I hope my review will do the same thing.
I ordered dynamite chicken, butter chicken and pilau rice and my husband ordered sweet and sour chicken, egg fried rice and noodles. Oh and fresh orange juice. We were impressed by the food, it was tasty and presentable. Let’s face it, saudi is not known for food if anything they have a bad reputation when it comes to food. This place was enjoyable, pleasant and welcoming. The waiter greeted us and allowed us to choose our table. Please note this place is about 15 mins away from the haram which we got a taxi to take us there. Baring in mind it was very quiet inside the restaurant. The decor was pleasant and modern. However the air freshener was slightly overpowering but it didn’t put us off the food. (Hey at least it didn’t smell bad). Overall - I would recommend this place. I love how it’s infused by Chinese and Indian food. The Egyptian man was welcoming and friendly, I can’t remember his name. Thank you sir.

Nando's is a great restaurant to visit if you're looking for some delicious and spicy chicken dishes. However, one drawback of this restaurant is that the prices are quite high and may not be suitable for everyone's budget. That being said, if you're willing to splurge a little, the food quality and flavour make the extra cost worthwhile.
The restaurant has a great ambiance, with a very attractive decor and comfortable seating. The staff are friendly and welcoming and the customer service is top-notch.
The chicken dishes at Nando's are definitely the main attraction and they do not disappoint. The chicken is succulent, juicy, and cooked to perfection with a flavorful marinade that packs a punch. The sides are also a highlight, from the delicious peri-peri fries to the coleslaw that complements the main dish perfectly.
Overall, Nando's is a great restaurant for those who enjoy a fiery, flavorful chicken, but keep in mind that the prices are quite steep, so it may not be the best choice if you're on a tight budget.

Its a shame I have to write this review publicly since this branch will never pick up their phone to deal with customers.
After being a regular customer at both the Dhahran mall branch and this branch, I am truly appalled and can no longer excuse the extremely poor food quality from the Ajdan branch in my recent delivery orders.
I know almost all the staff on a first name basis, I've come dozens of times and brought many friends, and the dining experience was very good.
However, there is a real issue when it comes to delivery items! This is maybe the 10th time I have ordered from them through delivery apps and have had a terrible experience.
The kitchen staff seem to make their own rules! My avo feta is almost always missing the literal avo feta sauce! Instead, they DRENCH it in mayo even when I explicitly ask for no mayo at all. Why do they get to choose my own food replacements?
Ok, lets assume they ran out of avocado or feta, even a 5 year old could fry chips better than this branch. Every single time its either raw or brown and burnt leaking of frying oil. Chicken is always always always overcooked! I might as well be eating styrofoam at this point!
I have looked past the inedible food delivered to me several times now, I have tried countless times to contact the branch and address my issue, but there has never been any response.
I will no longer frequent as much as I used to since this low quality is becoming a pattern.

Allah bless the management and staff
And please please please

A very lovely little hideaway place in the bustling JLT area. We came in the evening and place was bustling with online orders, but the staff were working so in sync to the point of it being mesmerizing. The food was delicious, highly recommend the Beef Sauté with Vegetables and the lil green drink in the attached pic, it’s not too sweet or too sour (a perfect mix in my opinion). The Pho Bo soup was so flavorful and not watered down at all, we should’ve ordered much a bigger plate, something to remember for next time (cuz we will definitely come back). The bill was on average less than 80 AED per person, so price wise we were very satisfied. The lovely staff and the chef are from Vietnam, so they are very knowledgeable about the food and can tell you all about it (it was a very very educational experience as well). 11/10 would recommend for anyone to try the restaurant out 🤩

column9:
What sets Saigon Vietnam Food apart is the attention to detail in each dish. The use of fresh ingredients and traditional cooking techniques truly pays homage to the authenticity of Vietnamese cuisine. It has outside seating with a lovely view of the water. Great setting for winter months.
The pricing at Saigon Vietnam Food is reasonable, considering the quality and portion sizes. It's a great place to enjoy a flavorful meal without breaking the bank. We had the vegetarian mix platter, lemongrass chicken grill with vegan fried noodles. We had the house mocktail special which was really nice and a cold jasmine tea. The staff are really friendly and willing to take requests for allergy and taste preferences.
Saigon Vietnam Food is a hidden gem in Dubai's culinary scene. If you're a fan of Vietnamese cuisine or simply looking to explore new flavors, this restaurant is a must-visit. With its welcoming ambiance, attentive service, and exquisite dishes, it offers an great dining experience that will leave you craving more. I recommend Saigon Vietnam Food for a taste of Vietnam in the heart of Dubai.
Vegetarian options: Lots of options
Parking: Depends on the rush...or else there are parking slots.

column9:
Exceptional authentic Vietnamese food, served by Vietnamese and cooked by Vietnamese, it can’t get better than this! Quaint little hole in the wall, extremely reasonable prices for Dubai, and the food came out very quickly even on a busy Sunday afternoon.
Loved every dish! Bun Cha was FANTASTIC! Loved the chicken patties and fried spring rolls, oh man. So was their chicken and shrimp Viet Crepe and Sautéed Beef served on a hot plate — the beef was super tender, and the marinade was extra flavourful. Love the generous servings of Nam Plaa as well. We closed our meal with a delicious Iced Vietnamese Coffee and Fried Biegnet with sweetened condensed milk. Both were delicious. We will be back!
One comment: the air conditioner was blowing very intensely at us and we had to relocate tables. Not sure if customers would appreciate such a strong cold wind blowing at their face.

Listen up, foodies! I have a review that will make your tastebuds water with anticipation. Let me take you on a journey to the heart of indulgence at the Cheesecake Factory. Yes, it's expensive, but trust me, it's well worth it!
First up, I tried the cheeseburger spring rolls. Oh my, oh my, oh my... these were outstanding! The perfect appetizer that was big enough to fill me up. Who needs a main course when you've got these heavenly rolls in your life? Plus, the raspberry drink was flowin' with free refills. I know what you're thinking, and no, I didn't stop there.
I had to try their burrito, and let me tell you, it was huge! This was no ordinary burrito, my friends. It was more like a work of art that you eat with a knife and fork. With toppings galore, this thing was impossible to pick up and eat, but I didn't care. The deliciousness was worth the struggle.
But, let me tell you, I would come back for the raspberry drink alone. That thing was like a party in my mouth. I could have chugged it all night long and still wanted more.
So, if you're feeling a little fancy and want to treat yourself to some food that will leave you feeling satisfied, head on over to the Cheesecake Factory. Your wallet may be hurting a little, but your taste buds will thank you.

column3: Askim Restaurant and Cafe (مطعم ومقهى أشكم)
column9:
My friend and I decided to stop by this restaurant around 3pm after a tiring 3-hour walking tour, craving a hearty meal to rejuvenate us. We opted for their Jaforda salad and for entree chicken slices in creamy lemon sauce and stuffed chicken with rice, accompanied by two iced lattes to perk us up.
The restaurant boasted a pleasant ambience with ample staff, all remarkably attentive. Our server seemed to be in training, but the manager's presence ensured smooth service throughout. The salad was delightful, although initially tangy, it complemented the chicken dishes impeccably. The chicken in creamy sauce was particularly savory, and the stuffed chicken, reminiscent of marinated rotisserie chicken, was bursting with flavor, accompanied by perfectly cooked rice. The portion sizes were generous, leaving us unable to finish everything.
However, a few aspects dampened our experience. Firstly, the restaurant's policy of not serving tap water as an alternative to bottled water was disappointing. Despite my inquiry, the server insisted only bottled water was available, which felt unnecessary. Additionally, the automatic addition of a tip to the bill was unexpected, especially considering our recent dining experiences elsewhere. Lastly, while we opted to sit inside to avoid the heat and insects, the constant stream of flies due to the open door made for a rather bothersome dining atmosphere.
Overall, while the food quality and service were commendable, the aforementioned issues detracted from an otherwise enjoyable meal experience.
column12: Askim Restaurant and Cafe (مطعم ومقهى أشكم)_Sunshine Eeee_1

Very far from Japan (or even Asia, not even substandard ramen place in HK) level but some things are good.
Tofu + eggplant starter 5/5: have seen one or the other in Japan, combining both very clever and super tasty. Best dish.
Mocktails 5/5: very refreshing super tasty
Octopus skewers 0/5: obviously burnt. Tastes burnt. Looks burnt. Weird a place would actually serve that.
Chicken skewers 3/5: pretty good nothing special, too salty.
Sushi fish rice 4/5: for Dubai really good, had some fatty tuna in there, yum yum.
Ramen 3.8/5: nice to eat good ramen in Dubai, just nothing special again and also very salty. So, good for Dubai, but far from even a Shoryu in London. No point to even compare with Asia standard.
Beef Tenderloin side 5/5: bravissimo 👌
Matcha parfait 2/5: served in an old wooden box. Ice cream on point. Matcha far too rich and not worth the calories. More like eating cake mix than a delicate dessert.
Food overall too salty, and adds to the general experience of it not being clean.
Cleanliness 0/5: it’s a Japanese place so again very weird. Take off shoes to then put my feet in an area which isn’t clean. Bathroom dust everywhere, probably used to be super nice but I just see dust on stuff that’s on the ground everywhere like toilet scrubber etc. again super weird, just clean the place guys come on. Japanese toilet very cool though.
Price: would be more careful with ordering next time. Not really worth it in my opinion but that’s just me, people can like what they like it’s ok.

The restaurant atmosphere is nice, and the fact that we see the pizza in the making is great.
The food tastes good, and I am sure that this restaurant used to be even better. This is a general observation related to almost all the restaurants in this area.
The food and the prices are very similar to piatto resturant.
Being someone from Riyadh city, I can say that generally, the food quality in Riyadh is better.
This restaurant was able to be up to the par, yet they need to go above and beyond as the customer base targeted is not easy to satisfy.
Overall, the fact that they are next to Jeddah corniche is a great addition, and the option to sit outside when the weather is good is also nice.
As usual, I hope this restaurant maintains this food quality or even makes it better in the future.

A top choice for an authentic Vietnamese restaurant in Dubai. The menu covers some very iconic Vietnamese dishes then adds some of their own creations that are somewhat fusion or modified for the local market but grounded in Vietnamese cuisine and flavours.  On the drinks side you should look out for Vietnamese coffee if you like a strong and sweet robusta coffee, and bubble tea which for a non-specialist with very limited variety is OK.
The food is overall excellent with fresh ingredients, balanced flavours and textures, and many of the dishes are quite healthy.  This restaurant definitely rates highly for delicious Vietnamese food in Dubai.
Service (from the entirely Vietnamese staff when I was there) is friendly and very pleasant to deal with.  There's some tables indoors but even more outside that, given it's upstairs on the balcony, has good views over the lake.

Who said healthy food can't be delicious?! As a self-proclaimed carnivore, I was initially sceptical about trying vegetarian Pan-Asian cuisine. But one visit to the beautiful Dip Dash in Barsha, and I was blown away!
The food packs an authentic punch of flavour, despite being entirely vegetarian (not even egg!). I tried a variety of dishes, each with unique spices and textures. Here are some must-tries:
1.	Nigiri Mosaic: This visually stunning platter comes with nine pieces, each with unique ingredients and taste profiles. Can you imagine having jackfruit on a nigiri? Oh, it tastes so good!
2.	Pan-Fried Half Moon: These golden parcels are cooked to perfection and pair beautifully with Dip Dash's delicious homemade dips. The sauce I tried had a delightful kick, complementing the filling perfectly
3.	So Much Fudge: Chocolate lovers, rejoice! This dessert is pure indulgence without the guilt. The rich, creamy texture creates an unforgettable experience, you will want more for sure!
4.	Vanilla Panna Cotta: My personal favorite for its textural symphony. The smooth panna cotta melts in your mouth, while the nutty crumble adds a delightful contrast.
I couldn't resist trying their Kimchi Rice and Multigrain Bao, and let me tell you, the photos I took don't do them justice! The jackfruit in the Bao had a delightful smokiness, and the rice was flavourful without being too spicy.
Beyond the incredible food, the service at Dip Dash is exceptional. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the owner/manager is a lovely lady who passionately explains the restaurant's journey and helps you choose the perfect dishes from the menu. My conversation with her added a personal touch to the experience, making me feel truly welcome.
If you're looking for an adventurous culinary journey with vibrant flavours, warm hospitality, and a commitment to delicious, plant-based cuisine, Dip Dash is a must-visit! Vegetarians and meat-lovers alike will be surprised and delighted. Trust me, you'll go back for more!
PS: (This is not a paid review, I just really loved the food!! 😊)

Great ambience and nice opportunity to get away from the hustle and bustle of the Atlantis hotel. Loved the aquarium view totally relaxing view of the marine. Food wise. Some controversial dishes I must say. I wasn’t a fan of the onion and mashmellow I just didn’t get it but my husband liked it! The “hot dog” tasted very average. My husband did not like the smoked salmon and caviar ball at all and found it sickening . The only dishes that stood out for both of us was the mushroom dish and the foie  which was cool. Mont  blanc desert, I did not like at all and gave it to my husband ( it tasted cheap and bland). The olive desert was interesting and a nice experience. We also liked the red mullet dish but again not mind blowing. I like the urchin dish and the oyster (husband didn’t). They did bring out cake with candle for my birthday which was nice and a gift to take home which I loved. Highlight of it was the chef coming to greet us which was lovely. Finally the non alcoholic drinks were not good at all sorrrry. So overall some interesting dishes ( mushroom, foie, urchin and olive) some medium like the red mullet and some poor tasting ( onion, mont blanc, smoked salmon) . Nevertheless we enjoyed our night and had a great experience.

🍽️Food: 5/5
🤵🏽‍♂️Service: 3/5
  Ambiance: 5/5
📝Notes: I came across this restaurant as it’s listed #11 in MENA’s 50 Best Restaurants (Previously at #7 in 2023). At first I was really excited and was hoping that they would accept walk in reservations. But then they told me to wait for 20 minutes to maybe see if someone would cancel or not. That bummed me out. As soon as I was about to head out, luckily they were able to get us a table :)
The ambiance is so detailed, a combination of bar seating, indoor/outdoor seating and of course, zashiki which is awesome since you get to sit on the floor 😁 Apart from the hip-hop music, I really felt like I was at a restaurant in Japan, but Kendrick kept reminding me that I was not 😆
The service that night wasn’t the best, I’ll be honest. And no it’s not because the hosts asked me to wait for 20 min, thats a small part as they are the first person I meet from the restaurant staff, but it does add up. For me it was the fact that we had to wait around 10 minutes just for someone to take our order, and the spacing between the appetizers and main also adds up. Lastly to ask for the bill. I had to ask two different staff members, it definitely was packed but for a restaurant to be in the top 15 MENA restaurants, I expected a better service. They were nice but its the little things thats adds up
As for the food, I cannot express how much I highly recommend the Wagyu Tsukune 😍 It is the best beef skewers I’ve ever had, and with the egg yolk on the side, you cannot miss out!! Both the Burnt Butter Scallop and the Miso Butter Eggplant are good, I would try something else just to see what else they have thats good.
As for the Spicy Miso Ramen, it’s good and creamy but its not my cup of tea when it came to the ramen itself (it felt very hard to break down as the noodles were stuck together)
Overall, it was a combination of great things as well as areas of improvements, I will definitely be coming back here to try out their other ramens as I heard the Shio Patian and the Tantamen are really good 👌🏼

The freshness and deliciousness of the ramen makes it a must-try for any food enthusiast as it comes close to the ramen I’ve tried in Japan. Additionally, their eggplant dish stands out with its unique flavors and excellent taste. The Wagyu skewers with the egg yolk dipping sauce was also very tasty, while the gyoza, although good, may not stand out as much. Overall, Kinoya Japanese Food is highly recommended, especially for those looking for authentic tasting Ramen in Dubai.

Kinoya: A Haven for Ramen Enthusiasts
If you're a fan of ramen, Kinoya is a must-visit Japanese restaurant that promises an unparalleled authentic experience with every bowl. I recently had the pleasure of dining there and was blown away by the culinary journey it offered.
Upon perusing their menu, I couldn't resist trying their Shio Paitan Ramen, Spicy Miso Ramen, and Duck Ramen. Each bowl was a symphony of flavors, meticulously crafted to perfection. The Shio Paitan Ramen boasted a delicate balance of saltiness and richness, while the Spicy Miso Ramen delivered a fiery kick that left my taste buds tingling in the best possible way. As for the Duck Ramen, it was a revelation – tender slices of duck swimming in a broth that was nothing short of ambrosial.
To complement the ramen, I indulged in some of Kinoya's tantalizing sides. The Chicken Karaage was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, a true delight with every bite. The Chicken Dumplings were equally impressive, bursting with savory goodness. And let's not forget about the Miso Butter Eggplant – a heavenly combination of flavors that left me craving more.
While the food was undeniably exceptional, it's worth noting that Kinoya's seating arrangements are a bit cramped. However, this is a common feature of Japanese dineries, adding to the authenticity of the experience.

Wow what an incredible place, definitely a must try if you’re in Dubai. So many people recommended this place to me and it’s very worth it. I got the Shio Paitan Ramen, which was the classic chicken broth, slightly creamy with a strong but delicious dashi flavor. Served with seared chicken thigh, and wow let me tell you, super super juicy chicken pieces with a crunch skin, literally perfection when eating with the fresh noodles. Also came with an egg, cooked perfectly with a jammy yolk and drizzled with burnt garlic oil. I got the large size and was a perfect size for me. For dessert I got the Flan which was a nice small treat to end the meal. The location was beautifully designed, Japanese old style.

It was a nice experience mostly, but we made a mistake in sitting outdoor (May 4) and it was too hot that we had to leave early as there are no external ACs or fans.
Welcoming was nice, the service was not that great as we had to wait a lot before someone took our order, also the shisha guy was hard to catch haha. The food really good, we tried several appetizers like hummus with meat, fattoush, avocado corn salad, grilled cheese rools, mousakhan rolls, batata harra and falafel, most were amazing except for the falafel.
For dessert we tried cotton candy ice cream, also not that great but it was nice to cool a bit.
The interior design is really nice.
I checked their platters menu and I look forward to try it as it looks (and smells) really delicious.
Better reserve before visiting.

I love Zuma Dubai; it has the best party vibe on Fridays and Saturdays. We've tried many bars, but we always end up back at Zuma.
Since moving to the UAE, I've often heard that Zuma has the best Asian food in Dubai. While the food is good, I believe there are other places in Dubai with better Asian cuisine. With so many recommendations to try Zuma's food, I had high expectations and found it not quite as exceptional as I'd hoped.
However, the cocktails at Zuma are outstanding. The Ricatonic, margarita with black salt, and espresso martini shots are excellent!
If you plan to visit the bar, come before 10 PM, as it gets super packed after that.

I recently dined at Superbowl Asian cafe, and I must say, this place is an absolute gem. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm welcome and a vibrant atmosphere. The decor is modern yet comfortable, creating a relaxing environment for a great meal with friends or family.
No visit to Superbowl Asian cafe would be complete without dessert, so we indulged in the brownies with ice cream. It was a true showstopper, with a sweet brownies and creamy vanilla ice cream inside., it was the perfect ending to a fantastic meal.
The service at Superbowl was top-notch. The waitstaff was attentive without being intrusive, ensuring our drinks were always full and that we had everything we needed. They were also knowledgeable about the menu and provided excellent recommendations.
Overall, Superbowl Asian cafe exceeded my expectations in every way. The food was outstanding, the service was impeccable, and the ambiance was inviting. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick lunch or a leisurely dinner, Superbowl is the perfect spot for an unforgettable dining experience. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for delicious Asian cuisine in a welcoming setting.

Possibly the best ramen in the entire region. Every bite had its own sound effect echoing deliciousness. Fresh, juicy, scrumptious, and prepared with love and care. By far the star of the evening even if we did wait a little while for the ramen to arrive at our table.
The appetizers were just as phenomenal. Shrimp tempura, Miso butter eggplant, Wagyu Tsukune, and the gyoza were worthy of being at the same table as the ramen. Matching the exquisite taste.
It’s an enjoyable atmosphere if you’re sitting outside and the next time I visit I will be tempted to try their private rooms. The place is elegant without being pompous, friendly without being overbearing, and charming on all fronts. The music that night was equally enjoyable. A hip-hop playlist that will keep your head bopping.

Wish I had tried this place earlier. I underestimated it. Really good food, and the ramen is probably the best around. I loved the ramen bar, it’s very cozy and you see your ramen prepared in front of you and served immediately. The bar seats are not for everyone though.
What I like about the chef (Neha Mishra) is that she’s quite serious about ramen. She got all the details right, which is even more impressive knowing that she’s not Japanese and the fact that ramen in Japan is predominantly made by men, so kudos to her for standing out. In fact, Kinoya is not about ramen only. The wagyu skewers, the miso eggplant, and the gyozas were all very delicious and executed very well to the point where I think you could totally skip the ramen (but of course, you shouldn’t). The miso eggplant was my favorite. The bonito flakes go really well with the eggplant (but don’t overdo it with the bonito flakes). Anyways, don’t come here expecting that it is purely a ramen joint. They have a lot of other options as well, including dessert (highly recommend the Hokkaido cheesecake!)
As for the ramen, we had the shio paitan ramen, spicy miso ramen, and the duck ramen. The duck ramen was surprisingly good, especially the side: duck leg in a sweet sauce. It sets Kinoya apart from the competition. The sweet sauce is not just “sweet sauce”. I feel like it deserves a better name. It’s an interesting sauce made from duck fat, and it packs an Umami punch. Try mixing some in the ramen “little by little throughout” (as recommended in the menu) and enjoy your ramen getting more and more delicious! The server said “do not mix the sauce with the ramen” without elaboration. You should not mix the ENTIRE sauce as the ramen will get too sweet. That is definitely true. But you can mix a little bit until you get the perfect balance. Believe me, it will make the broth tastes better. I got that tip from the menu. The duck ramen is indeed pricey, but because it’s “Silver Hill” duck (regarded as one of the best in the world) and they’re generous with it. The other ramens were great, too. The spicy ramen packs more flavor, but I also really enjoyed the shio ramen. If you’re looking for something non-standard, go for something different from the shio ramen. But you won’t go wrong either way. Other than the broth, I have to say that the noodles itself here is way better than any other ramen noodles I tried in the UAE. This place ramens.
The lady preparing the ramen for us (her name is Donabell if I’m not mistaken) was very meticulous and professional. I enjoyed watching her prepare the ramen with great care. Our server (Leo) was helpful and prompt with all our requests. Thanks a lot! I will come back for sure.

column3: Bosporus Turkish Cuisine - The Dubai Mall - مطعم بوسبورس دبي مول
column9:
What we ordered: Bosporus Mixed Grill + Plain White Rice.
Our experience: As a starter for our lunch, we were served a giant airated flat bread topped with sesame seeds. It also came with a small serving of well-prepared hummus as a dipping sauce. This was a simple dish and the combination worked well as an appetizer.
A while later we were served the mixed grill dish that was richly spiced and mouth - wateringly aromatic (I believe it was the parsley). The meat we were served was fresh, tender, and juicy, and the leftover hummus from earlier added to the already spectacular taste palette of the whole dish.
I'm not sure what else went into preparation of the hummus other than chickpeas, but I'm certain it can take your plain white rice to another level (bc that's what it did for us!).
When we were done with our main course, we were served complimentary black teas (I don't know if it was Turkish tea or just regular tea), and oh what a delight they were! It is served without any sugar so you can enjoy it as you please. It made dining here feel like such a treat and what better way to wrap up a lunch from here?
It was our first time trying Turkish cuisine and all in all, we had a positive experience.
Highlights: (1) Our waiter, who was educated and aware enough to adjust our service and orders to accommodate my gluten intolerance. She did her best to keep me safe from allergens and to keep cross contamination to a minimum (2) The complimentary bread+hummus and tea.
Suggestion: Generally speaking, all of our stomachs would be happier if the serving sizes were upgraded to include some more in quantity, especially with the grills.

FAB experience all around!!!!!
I’ll start by saying the staff at this place are amazing. They really go the extra mile to make you feel welcome and taken care of and if you have any allergies or dietary restrictions, this is the place to go because they will take good care of you and make sure to accommodate your needs, which is pretty special. Van actually even came to meet us and walk us through the menu.
Now the food — unreal. All fresh and sourced sustainably. They really take care & craft in providing good food with an authentic foundation. The staff are all Vietnamese and use traditional techniques. We had the starter platters (amazing), vegan pho (even the small is huge), the aubergine and tofu clay pot (super nice flavour), and bubble tea. All was fabulous. Thanks for a great experience!

Wine Pairing Price = $230 USD (or 845 UAE for the Metanoia Pairing)
Retail Value = $42 USD
Markup = 540% (likely closer to 420% with newly removed alcohol tax)
(Dined in July 2022)
Overall a fairly high markiup but given the alcohol restriction (Of the 52 wine pairings I've analyzed, this is in the 4th highest markup), however, in Dubai when I dined there was a 30% import tax on alcohol, which was removed in January '23.  If that reduced the cost of the menu, the restaurant would still be in the 75% of regarding markup.
The menu served 8 pairings; 1 sparkling, 4 white, 1 sake, and 1 red and was roughly 100mL pours.  The on standout was a pour of 2015 Puligny-Montrachet (also the oldest vintage) roughly $125 per bottle.  5 of the wines, you could find by the bottle between $21-$33 in most countries.   Full list of wines below.
The ambiance was wonderful, staff was fantastic, the food was lovely.  The chef came out to speak and was genuinely engaging.  I would visit again.

column9:
Nestled in the heart of Difc, Mamaesh Restaurant offers a delightful culinary journey into Palestinian cuisine. Known for its warm hospitality and authentic flavors, Mamaesh captures the essence of traditional Palestinian dishes with a modern twist.
The highlight of our dining experience was undoubtedly the fatayer, savory pastries filled with a variety of ingredients like spinach, cheese, or minced meat. Each bite was a perfect blend of crispiness and flavorful fillings, showcasing the chef's expertise in pastry making.
Accompanying our meal was a refreshing salad, bursting with freshness and vibrant colors. The ingredients were evidently sourced with care, enhancing the overall dining experience.
For the main course, we indulged in the chicken zatar wings, a tantalizing dish marinated in a blend of aromatic spices and herbs. The chicken was tender and infused with the distinctive flavors of zatar, leaving a memorable taste on the palate.
No Palestinian meal is complete without freshly baked bread, and Mamaesh excels in this department. The bread served was warm, soft yet perfectly textured, complementing every dish it accompanied.
The ambiance at Mamaesh is cozy and inviting, ideal for both intimate dinners and gatherings with friends or family. The staff was attentive and knowledgeable, offering recommendations that added to our enjoyment.
In conclusion, Mamaesh Restaurant stands out for its commitment to authenticity and quality. Whether you're a connoisseur of Palestinian cuisine or a newcomer eager to explore new flavors, Mamaesh promises a culinary adventure that won't disappoint. I look forward to returning soon to savor more of their delightful offerings.
